claim_boundary.may_say: A creator-evaluated local MVP executed a governed recovery workflow across 36 generated cases and produced reproducible synthetic evidence.
claim_boundary.must_not_say: Humans adopted or improved with the workflow, real customers recovered, value was realised, independent validation occurred, or a pilot or production deployment is authorised.

claims.statement: The frozen creator-evaluated denominator contains 36 synthetic cases.
Eligible simulated execution committed at 83.33% (15 of 18); this is not live reliability.
Three cases remain pending because authoritative postconditions were absent.
No preregistered exact-zero violation was observed in the sealed V6 run.
Provider cost was unavailable for every recorded attempt.
Provider latency was unavailable for every recorded attempt.
Hypothetical economics are inconclusive and do not support scale.
The evidence-led next-gate recommendation is PAUSE.
Five role-readiness packages are designed but not human validated.

comparison.limitation: Structural counts and virtual-time assumptions are not measured human effort or realised savings.

entry_conditions: the next pack is a new immutable identity
all 36 provider attempts capture cost and latency or explicit terminal unavailability
the action remains synthetic and local-MVP only
next_action.evidence_question: Can a new capped synthetic run achieve 18 of 18 eligible execution commits and complete cost/latency evidence while preserving every exact-zero control?
next_action.expiry_or_review_trigger: expires after 7 calendar days, 36 attempts, or the first stop condition
next_action.scope: one public, synthetic, local-MVP evidence action only
stop_conditions: any pre-run oracle exposure or source substitution
provider telemetry remains structurally absent after the first three attempts
the capped spend or attempt count is reached

decision.scope: synthetic creator-evaluated evidence; no live or company-pilot authorisation

enablement.claim_boundary: designed readiness controls; no human participation or adoption observed

roles.first_use_guidance: walk through the frozen evidence index and rehearse the stop/pause precedence before any use
